expected_target_fields.definition: Tracks how far the face-left lids have closed on the Apple coefficient scale. Zero denotes native neutral and one its native maximum; the calibration belongs to this provider. Only the native scalar is represented; validity must be provided separately.

assumptions: Valid scalar sample supplied with native calibration arkit.coefficient.v1:eyeBlinkLeft: face-relative native neutral-to-maximum coefficient.
Output preserves native coefficient meaning only; no cross-provider or visual equivalence.

rows.meaning_scope: Closure of lids over face-left eye
